relationship: TextOS's public site is onboarded as a production client of TextOS's Commit-to-Content input source, under the same rules as any client: TextOS is used strictly as a tool (textos/tool.json), and this file is the site's own onboarding record. Nothing here is written into TextOS.

ownedSurface.materialization: A TextOS ContentDocument@1, its lineage and its receipt are committed under textos/runs/**; lib/textos-client projects them into the site's insight catalogue and refuses any run whose hashes, citations or entities do not check.
ownedSurface.effectiveChannelReason: Commit-derived evidence carries no human public-use clearance yet, and the product truth is the certification candidate, not textos-v0 main. Every article stays a draft (Preview only, noindex) until a human review is recorded in its brief.

evidencePolicy: TextOS CONSERVATIVE_EVIDENCE_POLICY, not relaxed: on controlled_preview, operator-supplied evidence approved for the brief is usable; on public_web every statement class needs client_validated or public_source evidence with an explicit public-use clearance.

claimProfile.governance: Client-supplied data passed in the CTC intake. It is NOT a TextOS-governed catalog profile.

measurement.reason: No question panel has been approved for textos-site and no live observation key is available here. Following TextOS's own rule, no article is presented as coming from a measured opportunity: every target query is HUMAN_CMO with demand NOT_MEASURED.

commit_to_content.why: A product change + product truth + CMO interpretation → buyer question → target query (TextOS CTC seam). How-we-build engineering record; no capability claim, no CTA.
